summary: @or-sdk/permissions preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle unrelated to declared purpose
details: On npm install, package.json's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun) and then invokes it via execFileSync to run a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle using a numeric/string-array cipher and hex-mangled identifiers (WV8StW, MmgoCP, _0x-style names); its contents are unrelated to the package's advertised permissions-SDK purpose and it is not referenced from the declared main entry (dist/cjs/index.js). The bundle executes only through the preinstall -> Bun path, so the obfuscated code runs automatically on the installer's host at install time and cannot be inspected by ordinary Node-focused tooling. The package publishes to public npm under @or-sdk/permissions while its CHANGELOG references only gitlab.internal.onereach.io/onereach/platform/or-sdk-next, matching a dependency-confusion delivery shape targeting internal onereach.io consumers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
